name: sesha
description: Publish, verify, update, and react to shareable artifacts with Sesha (MCP 2026-07-28 & SEP-3415 events).

interface.shortDescription: Publish, share, and react to artifacts
interface.longDescription: Publish reports, visualizations, documents and related files to a durable share link. Verify uploaded metadata, update existing artifacts, restore retained file or folder revisions, and react to live artifact events via MCP SEP-3415 (Personal plan). Works with local stdio MCP, hosted MCP (https://app.sesha.sh/mcp), and the Sesha CLI. Uploads are public, unlisted links with optional passwords and expiration. Installing this skill does not grant publishing permission or connect an account.
defaultPrompt: Publish this report to Sesha and verify its share link.
Update my existing Sesha artifact without changing its link.
Watch my Sesha artifact and notify me when a recipient opens it.
